page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with numbered theses (167–180) running down the page; at the far right edge a narrow strip of another printed page (partly visible, with only a few fragments of letters, not transcribed as text).

main_text.p: 167 Doctrina de toto & partibus non est separanda à doctrina de distributione.
168 Distributio passivè pertinet ad totum, activè ad partes.
170 Omne totum est distributum vel actu vel potentiâ.
171 Omne totum est majus qualibet suâ parte.
172 Totum & omnes partes simul sumptæ sunt reipsa idem, quamvis differant ratione.
173 Nullum totum est, quod unicâ parte constat.
174 Totum continet partes singulas, ut majus quid; omnes, ut æquale & idem.
175 Quicquid habet affectionem communem ad varia, prout ita consideratur, est totum.
176 Quæcunque inter se opponuntur sub affectione communi ad unam, prout ita considerantur, sunt partes.
178 Omne membrum confert partem materiæ, partem formæ, integro.

page.notes: Right-edge strip belongs to the adjacent page and is not transcribed. Some Greek/print-specific letters in thesis numbers (e.g. "17 5", "17 6") are printed irregularly; "180" printed as "18 o". Running head and page number read from the top of the page.
